categories.main_business_segments: BGI Genomics primarily operates in gene sequencing and genomics services, including reproductive health research and clinical applications, tumor and chronic disease prevention and control, infectious disease control, multi-omics big data services and synthesis business, and comprehensive precision medical testing solutions. The company provides genetic testing, mass spectrometry testing, bioinformatics analysis, and AI-driven medical models to research institutions, enterprises, medical institutions, and public health organizations globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages high-throughput sequencing technologies such as NGS, Sanger sequencing, and single-molecule sequencing, combined with mass spectrometry, PCR, and bioinformatics platforms. It integrates AI and multi-omics data analysis, including genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and spatial omics. Production methods include process-based clinical development and application services, and order-based multi-omics big data and synthesis services, with strict quality control and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: BGI serves a diverse customer base including hospitals, medical examination institutions, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, third-party medical laboratories, government procurement platforms, and individual consumers. Its markets span reproductive health, oncology, chronic disease management, infectious disease control, and life sciences research globally, with significant presence in China and expanding international operations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China covering all provinces and major cities, with overseas presence in over 100 countries including regions in Europe, Africa, the Americas, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East. Key overseas subsidiaries and labs are located in Hong Kong, Europe (Netherlands, Denmark, Poland), the United States, Southeast Asia, and Latin America.
categories.supply_chain_position: BGI operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the genomics supply chain, focusing on genetic sequencing services, diagnostic testing, and bioinformatics analysis. It also engages in upstream activities such as gene synthesis and oligonucleotide production, supported by a vertically integrated supply chain including proprietary sequencing platforms and reagent manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in multi-omics technologies, AI integration, and digital health platforms. Key R&D directions include advancing whole genome sequencing, long-read sequencing, AI-powered genetic variant interpretation, and development of localized, automated precision medicine solutions. It aims to accelerate clinical translation, expand product lines in reproductive health, oncology, infectious diseases, and chronic disease management, and enhance global market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: BGI generates revenue through direct sales of genetic testing services, diagnostic reagents, sequencing instruments, and comprehensive precision medicine solutions. It employs a mix of direct sales and agency models, with contracts secured via commercial negotiations and government tenders. Revenue streams include service fees for testing and analysis, product sales, licensing, and technology transfer agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: BGI is a global leader in genomics and precision medicine, competing with domestic firms like Berry Genomics and international companies such as Natera, Illumina, Roche, and LabCorp. It holds a strong market position in China with extensive laboratory networks and technological capabilities, while actively expanding its international footprint and technological innovation to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, BGI reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.87 billion, a decline of 11.1% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 902.7 million, impacted by industry cycles, pricing pressures, and increased R&D investments. The company maintains substantial assets totaling RMB 12.54 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D with expenditures exceeding RMB 600 million, reflecting a strategic focus on long-term growth despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: BGI differentiates itself through its comprehensive multi-omics platform, integration of AI for intelligent data analysis and interpretation, and a broad product portfolio covering the full lifecycle of precision medicine from reproductive health to oncology and infectious diseases. Its proprietary sequencing technologies, extensive clinical collaborations, and localized automated solutions enable high-quality, scalable, and cost-effective genetic testing services globally, supporting personalized healthcare and public health initiatives.
